compiled_rule.technosphere_information_loss: Only the exact inspected ecoinvent 3.9 cut-off RER 16-32t Euro V freight market is reviewed. Source market contains one positive unit share of its full RER service. Source and target supply one tkm of complete transport life cycle, not vehicle-km, vehicle manufacture alone or a kg of truck. Factor +1 preserves signed caller tkm, supported uncertainty/formulas, foreground ownership and separately listed emissions/credits; no other source version, patch, inverse or cross-system-model route gains approval. Use only the nine available native RER Euro-V diesel services: 18t, 26t and 32t rated gross weight crossed with long haul, regional delivery and urban delivery. Each complete service has a positive one-tkm reference in native2025 and native2026. Their size/duty weights are the existing native 16-32t fleet coefficients conditional on Euro V and normalized within that subset. The inspected 2025/2026 nominal subset and coefficients are identical. This normalizes native proxy evidence, not the source inventory or caller tkm; no Euro III/IV/VI or electric/hybrid supply is included. The Swiss2020 native conditional size/duty distribution is a screening proxy because the source supplies only an average 16-32t Euro V service and does not resolve these weights. Native RER labels retain Swiss model/fleet provenance; original German/European HBEFA3.1 source emissions, payloads, routes, SCR/EGR mixture, upstream fuel, infrastructure, vintage and internal uncertainty can differ. Technology-year2010 labels identify the available native Euro-V models, not an IAM fleet forecast. Source/native numerical LCI, LCIA and stochastic equivalence and quantified score effects are not established. Retain complete native suppliers once and the original source one-tkm demand. Add no source operating emissions, fuel, truck, road, maintenance or end-of-life burden on top; do not scale by gross vehicle weight, payload, distance, fuel consumption, EURO-class emission ratio, capacity or lifetime. The previous unconditioned all-standards fleet-average draft is superseded and has no active source-3.9 Premise grant.
